commentary.text: 90+11' That's it for today, Chris Kavanagh has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+11' Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
90+10' What was Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
90+9' Manchester City work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

90+9' What an amazing save by Guglielmo Vicario! Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot towards the left side of the target, but fails. Manchester City win a corner.
90+7' Tottenham seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
90+7' Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle. Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) commits a foul after dangerous play.
90+5' Pep Guardiola has decided to substitute Erling Haaland and he is replaced by Julian Alvarez (Manchester City).
90+4' Tottenham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+2' We are about to witness a substitution. Mikey Moore (Tottenham) is replacing James Maddison.
90+1' The attendance for today's match is 61065.
90+1' 0 - 2 Goal! Erling Haaland (Manchester City) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Guglielmo Vicario into left side of the goal.
90+1' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) is going to take the penalty!
90' We will have 10 min. of added time.

90' Poor challenge! Pedro Porro (Tottenham) is penalised for tripping and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle. The referee blows his whistle and awards Manchester City a penalty after chaos inside the box.
88' Phil Foden (Manchester City) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
87' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) weaves through the defence and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score.
85' Here is a change. Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg is going off and Ange Postecoglou gives the last tactical orders to Oliver Skipp (Tottenham).
85' It is time for a substitution. Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham) is on for Pape Matar Sarr.
83' Manchester City enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

80' Rodri (Manchester City) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Chris Kavanagh with no other option than to blow for a foul.
79' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) drills in an effort from the edge of the box that climbs rapidly and goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Manchester City will have a goal kick.
79' James Maddison (Tottenham) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
78' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. Tottenham have been awarded a corner kick.
77' Tottenham control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
75' 2:3 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
74' Phil Foden (Manchester City) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
74' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Stefan Ortega pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
70' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) goes in the referee's notebook after being shown a yellow card.
69' Pep Guardiola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) replacing Kevin De Bruyne.
69' Stefan Ortega comes onto the pitch because Ederson (Manchester City) simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
69' Chris Kavanagh blows for a foul after Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
66' Ederson (Manchester City) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
66' Relief for Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) as the ref sticks to his original yellow card decision after the VAR review.
64' It’s not actually clear who made that challenge, so referee Chris Kavanagh will consult VAR before possibly issuing a red card.
63' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) is shown a yellow card by the referee for a bad sliding tackle on an opponent.
63' The game is interrupted now, Ederson (Manchester City) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
62' The resulting corner from James Maddison (Tottenham) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
61' James Maddison (Tottenham) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. Corner kick. Tottenham will have an opportunity.
60' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
58' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
57' Chris Kavanagh shows a yellow card to Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) for his blatant foul.
55' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Rodrigo Bentancur departs the field of play to be replaced by Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham).
51' 0 - 1 Goal! Erling Haaland (Manchester City) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Kevin De Bruyne, then sends the ball low into the middle of the net. 0:1.
51' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.

49' Excellent touch by Heung-Min Son (Tottenham)! He latches on to an inch-perfect pass deep into the box and unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper reacts superbly and makes a save.
47' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Guglielmo Vicario stops the ball from going inside right post.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+1' The end of the first half.
45' Phil Foden (Manchester City) is forced to stop his attacking move after the linesman signals for offside.

43' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
42' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) brings an opponent down and Chris Kavanagh interrupts the game. Manchester City win a free kick.
40' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) was too forceful with his tackle and Chris Kavanagh interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
39' A lofted pass into the box is met by Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City), who rifles a shot just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
38' A pass from Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham) is intercepted by Ederson and the move breaks down.
36' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Chris Kavanagh had an easy-decision to make.

34' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) gets to the ball from the resulting corner kick and attempts to curl it past the keeper. His wild shot sails wide of the goal. The ball goes out of play and Manchester City will have a goal kick.
34' James Maddison (Tottenham) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

33' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Ederson makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best! The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Tottenham.
31' Manchester City players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
27' James Maddison (Tottenham) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
27' A lofted cross from Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The referee signals a corner kick to Tottenham.
26' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
24' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Chris Kavanagh no option but to blow his whistle.
22' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
21' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Chris Kavanagh saw the whole situation.
18' James Maddison (Tottenham) prepares to take a corner kick.

18' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. Tottenham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
17' Flag goes up against Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
16' Phil Foden (Manchester City) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the left side of the goal. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save!
15' Phil Foden (Manchester City) sends the corner into the box, but Guglielmo Vicario intercepts it and averts the threat.
14' The corner from Phil Foden (Manchester City) is intercepted by the defence. Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick.

14' Kyle Walker (Manchester City) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Manchester City will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
12' The Manchester City players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
10' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Chris Kavanagh stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
9' The linesman signals that Kyle Walker (Manchester City) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
7' James Maddison (Tottenham) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

6' Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the roof of the net is blocked by Ederson, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. The ball is out of play. Tottenham win a corner kick.
5' The Tottenham players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
3' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) is penalised for a foul. Chris Kavanagh had a clear view and blows his whistle.
2' Manuel Akanji (Manchester City) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Tottenham will kick-off.
Chris Kavanagh was nominated as the referee for this game.
